_readme: The color code (B, 25 Oct 2026): one color per kind of show, on guide blocks, channels and show cards, with a legend in the guide. groups: in the order the legend shows them. types: the shelves whose shows take that color. genres: a show on a mixed shelf (British and Beyond, World TV, Classic TV, Streaming Era) takes the first group in genreOrder whose genres it has. adult: shown in the legend only behind the 18+ door. A show with no match is other. Change a color, a name or a shelf here; the next build uses it (scripts/lib/app.js colorOf; node --test tests/colors.test.js checks the file).
